payload.body:
Guild listing: Aephia Industries. Published by Phoenix Collective (Falkor's team) from the guild's own public text (shortened, verbatim excerpts; full text in ORIGINALS.md), supplied by the Founder.

Leadership: @[AEP] Funcracker, @[AEP] Viktor, and @[AEP] Dez

From Rock to Rocket — The #1 ship manufacturing guild in the Star Atlas Metaverse with branches in all 3 factions.

Aephia’s mission is clear: to become the premier manufacturer and seller of in-game spaceships, a vital and complex (to produce) asset in the game’s universe. Through our members’ combined resources, expertise, and industrial capabilities, we will produce top-tier ships to power the in-game economy.

Discord: https://discord.gg/aephia
